mapper.select: select colony_version from vm_platform_data_config where platform_code = #{colonyCode}

select colony_version as colonyVersion, wgt_version as wgtVersion, upgrade_url as upgradeUrl, upgrade_describe as upgradeDescribe, is_force_upgrade as isForceUpgrade, type as type from bs_wgt_upgrade_info where colony_version = #{colonyVersion} AND type = #{type} and delete_flag = '0'

SELECT t.id, t.colony_version AS colonyVersion, t.wgt_version AS wgtVersion, t.upgrade_url AS upgradeUrl, t.upgrade_describe AS upgradeDescribe, t.is_force_upgrade isForceUpgrade, t.type as type, t.parent_id as parentId, t.platform_code as platformCode, CASE WHEN t.upgrade_url IS NULL OR t.upgrade_url = '' THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS wgtStatus, t.creator, DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, t.modifier, DATE_FORMAT(t.update_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime, t.wgt_package_name AS wgtPackageName, t2.platform_name as platformName FROM bs_wgt_upgrade_info t left join vm_platform_data_config t2 on t.platform_code = t2.platform_code and t2.delete_flag = '0'
AND t.delete_flag = '0'
AND t.parent_id = 0
AND t.parent_id = #{param.parentId}
AND t.platform_code = #{param.platformCode}
AND t.parent_id IN
#{parentId}
AND t.colony_version like CONCAT('%', #{param.colonyVersion}, '%')
AND t.upgrade_url is null
AND t.upgrade_url is not null
AND t.is_force_upgrade = #{param.isForceUpgrade}
AND t.creator like CONCAT('%', #{param.creator}, '%')
AND t.create_time BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(#{param.createTimeStart},'%y-%m-%d 00:00:00') AND DATE_FORMAT(#{param.createTimeEnd},'%y-%m-%d 23:59:59')
AND t.modifier like CONCAT('%', #{param.modifier}, '%')
AND t.update_time BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(#{param.updateTimeStart},'%y-%m-%d 00:00:00') AND DATE_FORMAT(#{param.updateTimeEnd},'%y-%m-%d 23:59:59')
${param.dataScope} ORDER BY t.colony_version

select colony_version as colonyVersion, mini_program_version as miniProgramVersion, code_version as codeVersion from bs_mini_program_upgrade_info where colony_version = #{colonyVersion} and delete_flag = '0'

SELECT t.id, t.colony_version AS colonyVersion, t.mini_program_version AS miniProgramVersion, t.code_version AS codeVersion, t.creator, DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, t.modifier, DATE_FORMAT(t.update_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM bs_mini_program_upgrade_info t
AND t.delete_flag = '0'
AND t.colony_version like CONCAT('%', #{param.colonyVersion}, '%')
AND t.mini_program_version like CONCAT('%', #{param.miniProgramVersion}, '%')
AND t.code_version like CONCAT('%', #{param.codeVersion}, '%')
AND t.creator like CONCAT('%', #{param.creator}, '%')
AND t.create_time BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(#{param.createTimeStart},'%y-%m-%d 00:00:00') AND DATE_FORMAT(#{param.createTimeEnd},'%y-%m-%d 23:59:59')
AND t.modifier like CONCAT('%', #{param.modifier}, '%')
AND t.update_time BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(#{param.updateTimeStart},'%y-%m-%d 00:00:00') AND DATE_FORMAT(#{param.updateTimeEnd},'%y-%m-%d 23:59:59')
order by t.create_time
desc
order by t.update_time
desc
ORDER BY t.colony_version desc
